title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig into it.

items.headline_md: Overnight **Israeli strikes kill eight Palestinians** in Gaza City and central Gaza
items.summary_md: Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz said one strike killed Khaled Abu Nada, who oversaw Hamas' economic and education affairs in Gaza.

items.headline_md: Update: Saudi-led coalition says it **intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles** fired at **Riyadh** early Thursday
items.summary_md: It also downed two drones over the Eastern Province; no word yet on casualties or damage.

items.headline_md: A **fuel tanker crash on Cairo's Ring Road** sets off a fire that kills at least **31** and injures 21
items.summary_md: The blaze engulfed more than two dozen cars and motorcycles in Giza's Waraq neighborhood on Wednesday.

items.headline_md: Thailand's **Bangchak shuts its Bangkok refinery** after a fire injures at least **seven**
items.summary_md: The blaze at the 120,000-barrel-a-day Phra Khanong plant was out within 30 minutes; the cause is under investigation.

items.headline_md: China launches **Shenzhou-24** to Tiangong with its **first foreign astronaut**, a Pakistani payload specialist
items.summary_md: It's the first joint Chinese-foreign crew in China's human spaceflight program.

items.headline_md: **Nine miners found dead** in a flooded pit in Indonesia's **West Java**, with **17 still missing**
items.summary_md: High water, narrow access and poor lighting are slowing the rescue in the roughly 100-meter-deep mine.

items.headline_md: Update: The White House proposes **new tariffs on 14 trading partners**: up to **40% on China**, 35% on Vietnam, 20–25% for the rest
items.summary_md: The rates won't stack on July's tariffs and likely won't hit until February or March, so global stocks rose on relief.

items.headline_md: **Nvidia halts server shipments** to **Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia**, the FT reports
items.summary_md: Partners like Dell and Supermicro told buyers their orders can't ship; it's unclear if the pause is temporary while they work through new US export rules.

items.headline_md: **S&P puts Nvidia's credit rating on watch** for a possible downgrade, citing management and board oversight
items.summary_md: Nvidia closed Wednesday down 3.9% at $149.30, $2.3 trillion below its October peak.

items.headline_md: **Elon Musk** says every US child will get **two SpaceX shares**, a gift worth over **$18 billion**
items.summary_md: One share comes from the company and one from Musk personally, he posted on X.

items.headline_md: **AI data-center gear** keeps air cargo booming, says the CEO of **SATS**, the world's largest air cargo handler
items.summary_md: Server racks and chips are the main driver, and the Americas are now SATS' fastest-growing region.

items.headline_md: Mobile: **Block Blast** leads iOS ad creatives, and Learnings' **Vita Mahjong, Amaze Go and Meowdoku** take Android's top three
items.summary_md: Also: **Monopoly Go** passed **$8bn** lifetime, and six of Q3's top 10 hybrid-casual puzzlers by IAP were Pixel Flow-style flow puzzles.

items.headline_md: **EA Sports FC 27** adds **AI-recreated John Motson** commentary in today's 1.3.0 update
items.summary_md: His family agreed and was paid; a voice-cloning campaigner objects that Motson never consented himself.

items.headline_md: **Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 + 4** leads December's **PS Plus** games, with Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 and Amnesia: The Bunker
items.summary_md: They're claimable Dec. 1 to Jan. 4, 2027.

items.headline_md: Team Cherry's **Silksong: Sea of Sorrow** update comes **Friday at 9 AM CT** in a Cherry Time! broadcast
items.summary_md: Team Cherry promises "a bunch of exciting announcements"; the free expansion still has no release date.

items.headline_md: **skate.** drops seasons, its pass and Tix currency on **Dec. 1**
items.summary_md: Content will ship when ready; leftover Tix get one last auto-exchange, then are wiped.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still not public. u/Mindstormman's GitHub has 0 public repos, the r/decomps new feed shows no release, and the other Wii U recompilers ([CafeRecomp](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp), [RebrewU](https://github.com/ApfelTeeSaft/RebrewU), [nWiiURecomp](https://github.com/BlackLineInteractive/nWiiURecomp)) have no new pushes or releases.

items.headline_md: Update, GTA VI: private PC recomps reportedly hit **20–30 FPS** (one claim of 44), but there's **still no public, playable PC build**
items.summary_md: Builders went private after Take-Two's DMCAs; treat any "GTA 6 PC" download as malware.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: **Lichii Build 410**, an Eglantine fork, speeds up **Donkey Kong Bananza** and fixes AMD and GTX 10-series bugs
items.summary_md: It also fixes a Kirby Switch 2 Edition crash on AMD and broken colors in Xenoblade Chronicles 2.

items.headline_md: N64Recomp: **Rogue Squadron 64 Recompiled** brings Star Wars: Rogue Squadron natively to Windows, Linux, Mac and Android
items.summary_md: It adds widescreen, unlocked frame rates, 8x draw distance, optional ray tracing and VR; a web fork runs it in browsers.

items.headline_md: Legal: a **Nintendo DMCA** gets GitHub to disable **144 repos** for Picofly, SX Core and HWFLY Switch modchip firmware
items.summary_md: Chips already installed keep working, but new setups and updates can't pull firmware from GitHub.

items.headline_md: **RPCS3** looks back on 2026: direct **disc-drive play**, ISO support, a handheld UI and **10%+ more playable games**
items.summary_md: It also improved PS Move and microphone emulation and the macOS/arm64 builds.

items.headline_md: Update: **Sunrise on the Reaping** looks like **$15.5M–$16.5M** Wednesday and **$85M+** over the five-day holiday
items.summary_md: That would be the franchise's second-best Thanksgiving after Catching Fire's $109.9M, with about $233M domestic by Sunday.

items.headline_md: Update: Disney's **Hexed** opens to about **$7.8M** Wednesday (with $2.1M in previews), pacing for **$35M–$40M** over five days
items.summary_md: Deadline says the $200M original "isn't Coco or Frozen."

items.headline_md: Update: **Focker-in-Law** looks like a **$5.2M** Wednesday and **$36.1M** five-day, below the $45M forecast
items.summary_md: Ebenezer and I Play Rocky round out the top five; Netflix's Cliff Booth is pacing for $5M over five days in 251 theaters.

items.headline_md: **David Fincher** says AI re-lipped dialogue in **Cliff Booth** after early viewers spotted apparent generative-AI shots
items.summary_md: He says only 5% of the film used traditional ADR; Netflix and Fincher haven't addressed the specific shots.

items.headline_md: **Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie settle** their Château Miraval winery suit
items.summary_md: Terms weren't disclosed; Pitt's separate suit against Stoli owner Yuri Shefler goes on.

items.headline_md: The **FCC conditionally lets SpaceX deploy up to 1 million satellites** meant to be orbital AI data centers
items.summary_md: The FCC held back a requested waiver on disposing of some satellites outside the atmosphere.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** says proteins from **GPT-6.2** designs bound to all **five** intended targets in lab tests
items.summary_md: Specialized AI models supplied the sequences and helped pick candidates; OpenAI also posted a protein-design preprint.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic and OpenAI** each publish a claimed proof that **VP and VNP differ**, a long-open algebraic-complexity problem
items.summary_md: Both await independent checking; Anthropic says no human mathematician has checked its AI-written proof.

items.headline_md: **Phala** says an attacker could read **152,092 OpenRouter requests** sent to its experimental DeepSeek deployment
items.summary_md: The attacker also got the root key of Phala's legacy cloud key-management service.

items.headline_md: **Australia** passes a **digital duty of care** law that covers **AI chatbots** along with social media, games and apps
items.summary_md: It replaces existing safety frameworks and expands the eSafety Commissioner's powers.

items.headline_md: App stores: **Apple pulls Talkie**, MiniMax's AI companion app, worldwide over "sexual content" after a child-safety investigation
items.summary_md: It's still on Google Play, so parents of kids with Android phones should check.

items.headline_md: App stores: **32 states plus DC**, and Microsoft, Spotify and Match, back **Epic** in Apple's Supreme Court appeal
items.summary_md: Oral argument is set for **Jan. 11, 2027**.

items.headline_md: **1Password** says an intruder used an employee's GitHub account to copy some **customer names and emails**
items.summary_md: Vaults weren't touched and no password changes are needed, but expect convincing phishing.

items.headline_md: Ads: **Backblaze**'s new privacy policy, effective **Dec. 1**, lets it share customer data with ad networks for targeting
items.summary_md: You can opt out with the Your Privacy Choices link or Global Privacy Control, one browser at a time.

items.headline_md: A judge rules **Amazon must handle recalls** of **400,000+ products** sold through Fulfilled by Amazon
items.summary_md: Amazon must email buyers and post the notices on Your Orders; it says it's "reviewing our options."

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: US stock markets are **closed today for Thanksgiving**; futures and crypto are trading.

items.summary_md: These are changes from Wednesday's settles, after Wall Street clawed back most of Wednesday's early losses.
**Nvidia** fell **3.9%** to **$149.30** after S&P's credit watch.
Brent's change isn't shown because Yahoo's front-month comparison looks distorted.

items.headline_md: Crypto at 5:05 AM CT: **Bitcoin $60,413** and **Ether $1,691**, both about flat on the day
Overseas Thursday: **Europe +1.6%** early, **Nikkei +1.6%**, **Kospi +1.9%**, MSCI world **+0.4%**
items.summary_md: Investors read the new US tariffs as less damaging than feared.

items.headline_md: ⚠️ **Winter Storm Warning** until **noon CT today** for St. Peters and Berkeley: up to **2 more inches** of heavy, wet snow
items.summary_md: NWS reported 6–9 in. overnight in a narrow band from Perryville to Chesterfield. Snow turns to rain by late afternoon; slick roads this morning, and 20–25 mph gusts could snap snow-loaded branches and cause scattered power outages.

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: rain and snow early, then rain, high near **38°**, low around **33°** tonight; **83%** chance today
items.summary_md: About **0.4 in.** of precipitation, with little or no new snow after the morning; north wind gusting to 25 mph.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: rain and snow early, then rain, high near **37°**, low around **34°** tonight; **93%** chance today
items.summary_md: About **0.5 in.** of precipitation, with little or no new snow after the morning; north wind gusting to 26 mph.

items.headline_md: **US chip curbs and a distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development**
items.summary_md: Reuters' exclusive shows Z.AI's GLM-5.5 slipping and Moonshot's release cycle possibly doubling, a rare inside look at whether US export controls are working.
